thread:
Maria (Marketing): Quick flag — weekly KPI snapshot shows webinar signups down 22% W/W. top-line dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/launch-weekly :chart_with_downwards_trend:
Sam (Growth): ugh. did the landing page change the CTA? or is this an attribution thing?
Liam (Analytics): looking at raw events, total pageviews are flat but `lead_submit` events with utm params dropped by ~1.3k yesterday.
Riley (Ops): we deployed the new redirect proxy at 10:12am yesterday that rewrites some querystrings. I'll check routing logs.
Maria (Marketing): could be that. Noticed a higher bounce on the registration flow too. Any quick way to confirm UTMs were stripped?
Liam (Analytics): run this trace to compare: `SELECT utm_source, count(*) FROM events WHERE event='lead_submit' AND date='2026-04-05' GROUP BY 1` — I'm seeing a spike in "(none)".
Sam (Growth): if UTMs are gone, attribution will misassign to Organic. That explains lower campaign conversion in the dashboard.
Zoe (Product): also worth checking if the new copy test removed hidden fields? we toggled a JS snippet last week.
Riley (Ops): confirmed in proxy logs: `GET /r?dest=/launch?utm_source=eventbrite` -> proxied to `/launch` without querystring between 10:12–11:03am. Rollback in prod at 11:04am.
Maria (Marketing): timeline helps. That 52-minute window maps to ~1.1k missing UTMs — matches Liam's gap. Can we mark those leads as "manual attribution: eventbrite" for now?
Liam (Analytics): I can backfill attribution by matching referrer + timestamp where possible. Will add a flag `utm_inferred=true` for those rows. ETA 2 hours.
Sam (Growth): great — also let's update the dashboard: add a note / annotation for the spike window and a temporary metric `campaign_signups_adjusted` that uses inferred UTMs.
Maria (Marketing): thanks team. ACTIONS: Riley to add a permanent proxy rule to keep querystrings, Liam to backfill and tag, Sam to add annotation and adjusted metric, I'll prep comms for sales about the lead re-attribution. :white_check_mark:
kpi-bot: weekly_kpi_snapshot generated — overall CPL up 18% but adjusted campaign CPL (post-backfill) projection looks within normal range.
Zoe (Product): one more ask — can we add a lightweight E2E check on the registration flow to fail fast if querystrings are stripped? a single synthetic test should catch this.
Riley (Ops): yes I’ll add a synthetic that hits the redirect and asserts utm present. Will post PR in #eng-infra.
Maria (Marketing): perfect. I'll wait for Liam/Sam updates before I message Sales. Thanks everyone.
